title: HorizonCode ExecutionHost protocol dispatch receipt v1
description: Private durable ACK for one Guarded LSP/DAP protocol write. It confirms a complete framed write and persisted target receipt; it is not process, workspace, or capability authority by itself.

requestSequence.description: Positive per-process Core-to-HostKernel sequence shared by protocol_op and protocol_reply.

processIOSequence.description: Positive HostKernel-to-process stdin-frame sequence, distinct from requestSequence and inbound eventSequence.

operationDigest.description: BLAKE3 over canonical MessagePack [ExecutionProtocolOperationV1, protocol, requestSequence, operation], where protocol is lsp or dap and operation is the strict typed operation value.

dispatchReceiptDigest.description: BLAKE3 over canonical MessagePack [ExecutionProtocolDispatchReceiptV1.dispatch, hostProcessRef, effectID, challengeID, capabilityID, capabilityLeaseDigest, requestSequence, processIOSequence, operationDigest, acceptedFrameBytes]. HostProcessRef carries owner/profile/executable pins.
